reporting.window_note: Catch-up run: last successful ingest was 2026-08-08T08:34:40-04:00 (2026-08-09 through 2026-08-12 had no runs). This file covers the full ~5-day gap, 2026-08-08T12:34:40Z through 2026-08-13T12:30:00Z, not a single 24h day. Volumes below (new leads, drift, conversations) are 5-day totals, not daily rates.

exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 214 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just this window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 214 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A few contacts carry more than one lead: tag across duplicate opportunities (e.g. kulwant singh), so tag counts don't sum exactly to 214 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the Oct 2025 bulk-import batch and a handful of 240+ day Postponed records — see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a window-scoped metric). Consistent with the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale, drifting up as expected 18 days later.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 49 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (64 total, lifetime). Same data quirk noted in the Aug 8 run persists: of the 49 records returned under status=open, 13 sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' stage and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' despite an open status. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to the window's active conversations and mobile-quote-tagged contacts appearing in them; no violations found within that scope — all had outbound activity inside the 5-day quote_followup_days-equivalent window. A full account-wide sweep (last-conversation-activity vs. mobile-quote-send-date, joined properly rather than via opportunity updatedAt) was not attempted this run, same caveat as Aug 8.

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category, not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability).

reporting.gap_resolution_note: Several items flagged stuck in the 2026-08-08 run resolved themselves during the unattended gap: Bushrra Chaudhry and Luigi Marchesi auto-abandoned Aug 11, Ben (Burlington) auto-abandoned Aug 8, Abdul Khaliq closed lost Aug 8, and Armand Caluag Asuncion / Rose Vill were both categorized and moved to Warm Aug 8 (Rose has since declined the project). The abandonment automation and Albert's manual categorization are both working; the ones still open in this run (Bash Saqr, Zinat Hirji, and 9 others) are the genuine remaining backlog.
